thread:
elaine_pm: Quick sync — we ran a customer workshop this morning. Two SMBs and one mid-market account pushed hard for a rerank SLA (p95 <= 200ms) for >10k rps windows, and lower embedding tail latency for similarity search. Need to decide Q2 tradeoffs: prioritize rerank latency squeeze vs embeddings tail improvements vs scoped docs for Dedicated customers. cc @michael_eng @ravi_data

michael_eng: Thanks. Do we have signal on how many customers would actually pay for SLA vs ask via support?

ravi_data: I pulled the telemetry. For hosted customers with heavy rerank, 8 orgs account for ~65% of rerank qps. Embedding p95 is around 320ms on our current model mix; p99 spikes to ~1.2s under bursty traffic.

elaine_pm: Good call. Proposal: three priority slices — 1) Rerank latency SLO for top tier (canary + paid SLA), 2) Embedding tail reduction (platform-level; batching/caching & kernel selection), 3) Docs + contract language for Dedicated/Private (manual isolation). Which of these are must-have for Q2 MVP?

michael_eng: From infra POV: we can do a targeted rerank canary quickly (2 sprints) by tuning batching and adding a small dedicated pool for customers who opt-in. Embedding tail fixes require kernel work + smarter prefix caching — that's 3-4 sprints if we parallelize.

sara_se: From SE/customer view: customers will accept a paid SLA for rerank if it reduces variability. They also want deterministic billing for bursts. Docs alone won't cut it for mid-market.

elaine_pm: Ok. Rough acceptance criteria I'm thinking:
- Rerank canary: p95 <= 200ms for opt-in tenants at 5% traffic, no more than 5% error increase; rollout plan + rollback trigger.
- Embeddings: p95 <= 220ms baseline under defined trace workload (see snippet), p99 < 600ms for 99% of windows.
- Launch docs: explicit capacity commitment and pricing tiers for Dedicated.

michael_eng: Draft canary config (suggestion):
```
canary: {
  percent: 5,
  cohorts: ["opt-in-rerank"],
  metrics: { p95_latency_ms: 200, error_rate_pct: 1.0 }
}
```
Rollout play: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with automated rollback if p95 > 250ms or error_rate > 2.5%

ravi_data: We should add quality gates — rerank output change-rate vs baseline (embedding similarity jitter) so we don't regress quality for latency. Suggest metric: result drift <= 3% on evaluation set.

elaine_pm: Agreed. Add that to canary acceptance. Also need cost delta estimates for customers on opt-in. @michael_eng can you throw a rough delta for dedicated pool?

michael_eng: Quick back-of-envelope: small dedicated pool to hold headroom for rerank at those rates would be ~0.6x baseline cost per heavy customer. I'll give a more exact number with expected qps ranges by EOD.

sara_se: For launch messaging, we should prepare two docs: 1) "Rerank SLA — how it works" (technical + billing) and 2) "Embedding tail improvements — what to expect" (engineering caveats + timeline). I'll draft templates.

ops_bot: Reminder: create incident runbook checklist for canary rollouts. Use template: /runbook create rerank-canary-1716504321

elaine_pm: Next steps: (a) @michael_eng confirm cost delta + rough infra plan by EOD, (b) @ravi_data produce evaluation set drift check and exemplar traces by tomorrow, (c) @sara_se start doc templates and customer comms outline. We'll reconvene tomorrow at 11am PT to lock Q2 slice commitments. If anyone disagrees with priority ordering, flag now. :thumbsup:

michael_eng: Ack, will post numbers tonight.

ravi_data: On it. Will attach sample traces with percentiles.

sara_se: Drafting comms now, will share a short PR for feedback. :sparkles:

elaine_pm: Thanks team — goal is to get this scoped and in roadmap by EOD Friday.

michael_eng: Quick question — should we include quantization/precision changes as a separate opt-in? That might speed embeddings but impacts quality.

elaine_pm: Good point. Let's add a "quantization pilot" as a stretch item for Q2 but not blocker for the SLA launch. Put it in the backlog with a clear eval plan.

sara_se: I'll capture that in the docs: "quantization pilot — expected cost/quality tradeoffs"

ops_bot: Meeting scheduled: "Q2 hosted roadmap — rerank & embeddings" tomorrow 11:00 PT. Invite sent to participants.

elaine_pm: End thread.
